These are often on their second or third opener, meaning the hardware has seen years of use. Even in neighborhoods like Downtown Lombard or Westmore, local soil conditions and Chicago-area weather cycles demand regular attention. problemSigns.detail: Increased noise often indicates worn rollers, unlubricated parts, or loose hardware. Addressing these early prevents further damage.

process.description: We apply garage-door-specific lubricant to all hinges, rollers, and springs. This reduces friction and noise.
We check all fastener hardware and tighten loose bolts or nuts. Worn hinges are replaced as needed.
We test the spring tension and adjust it for proper door balance. This reduces strain on your opener.
We inspect the bottom rubber weather seal for cracks or wear. A new seal maintains energy efficiency and keeps out debris.
